div.div:
Full payment cycle
① checkout-saga registers the Payment (Registered, card validated)
② BasketCheckoutEvent → promotes it to Pending
③ CDC publishes PaymentRequestedEvent
④ Gateway decides and publishes the outcome
⑤ Payment consumers apply it to the table
⑥ Ordering consumes the same outcome in parallel
Compensation (ADR-0050 §1): if the cart changed before it closed, the saga voids the payment (Registered → Voided). A Registered payment never reaches the gateway.
With points (ADR-0048 §6): the Payment is promoted to AwaitingPoints and reaches ③ only after Challenges reserves them; a failed reservation declines it (InsufficientPoints) and Ordering cancels the order.

text.tspan: ① checkout-saga registers the Payment (Registered, card validated)
② BasketCheckoutEvent → promotes it to Pending
④ Gateway decides and publishes the outcome
⑤ Payment consumers apply it to the table
⑥ Ordering consumes the same outcome in parallel
Compensation (ADR-0050 §1): if the cart changed before it closed, the saga voids the payment
(Registered → Voided). A Registered payment never reaches the gateway.
With points (ADR-0048 §6): the Payment is promoted to AwaitingPoints and reaches ③ only after
Challenges reserves them; a failed reservation declines it (InsufficientPoints) and Ordering cancels
